missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Печка' stays in the nominative case as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Старая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'в углу' locates it in the corner.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Печку' is the accusative direct object of 'топит'. 'Дровами' is the instrumental of means, showing what fuels the fire.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Печки' takes the genitive after 'возле', meaning near the stove. 'Очень тепло' describes the cosy warmth there.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Печке' is the prepositional form after 'на', marking where the cat sleeps. 'Тёплой' is the agreeing feminine adjective.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Печке' is the dative after 'к', showing movement toward the stove. The verb 'подошла' agrees in feminine gender.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Печкой' is the instrumental after 'за', meaning behind the stove. 'Дрова' is the nominative plural subject of 'лежат'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Печки' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'греют'. 'Дома' is the accusative plural object, the houses being heated.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Печку' is the accusative object of 'купили'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'домой' marks the destination.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Печки' takes the genitive after 'от', marking the origin of the smoke. 'Дым' is the nominative subject of 'идёт'.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Печка' is the nominative subject of 'горит'. 'Весь долгий вечер' is an accusative time expression spanning the whole evening.
